name: Film Strip
description: The picture slips like film in a projector gate: it shrinks to show the sprocket holes, the strip runs down with motion blur and a slight weave, then the second clip's frame lands in place. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: frames
params.description: Number of frames that slip by

params.name: shrink
params.description: How much the picture shrinks during the slip, showing the film's edges

params.name: blur
params.description: Length of the motion blur at full speed

params.name: weave
params.description: Amount of horizontal weave and vertical jitter

params.name: film_color
params.description: Color of the film around the pictures and of the line between frames

params.name: hole_color
params.description: Color of the light through the sprocket holes
